overview.en:
Inspect pipelines, builds, jobs and test results and manage CI workflows in Buildkite.

Investigate build and delivery workflows with the selected pipeline and run in view. Keep logs, statuses, and proposed remediation steps separate.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
在 Buildkite 中查看流水线、构建、作业与测试结果，并管理持续集成工作流。

围绕选定流水线与运行记录调查构建和交付流程，分别呈现日志、状态与拟议修复步骤。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Investigate this failed run and summarize the relevant logs.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 调查这次失败的运行，汇总相关日志。

starterPrompts.en: Compare the available results from these two pipeline runs.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这两次流水线运行的可用结果。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a remediation plan for this pipeline issue.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个流水线问题准备修复方案。

descriptions.en: Use Buildkite in Ghast. Inspect pipelines, builds, jobs and test results and manage CI workflows in Buildkite. 在 Buildkite 中查看流水线、构建、作业与测试结果，并管理持续集成工作流。
